reviews.title: Fast and Reliable RAM, RGB Lighting Can't Sync with Preinstalled RGB Lighting
reviews.comment: Fast and Reliable. My computer recognized them immediately and ran just fine without any issues. The only thing I don't like (and may just be my computer), but they use a different RGB lighting software (Signal RGB) to control them, but my computer uses a different RGB software, so I couldn't get these to run the exact same colors and sync with the rest of my lights. I got them close, so not that big of deal. Overall the performance is more of the reason I got them and the price was great, so I returned my original Corsair RAM and glad I did.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: Good performing RAM.
reviews.comment: This RAM does what I expected. BIOS XMP was not enabled, easy fix and once enabled, all the timings and voltages came up immediately and started working. I can't complain about performance, ascetics however... not a fan of the dark gray and white with red highlights. Just personal preference though. Overall, I am happy with the product and it works great. Thanks Patriot.
reviews.author: will

reviews.title: Fast, flawless and colorful
reviews.comment: The RAM arrived on-time and in excellent shape. As a builder of PCs for personal and business use since 1982, I was always looking to increase speed and capacity. This is the first new build I have done in 5 years and other than the excitement of a blazingly fast machine, all of the components that can be seen, including the case itself. now glow in multi-color hues. It's very cool.
